english: At Reborn, we are committed to creating an environment where players can freely express themselves. We believe in free speech as a fundamental human right—including your ability to communicate without fear of over-policing or unwarranted moderation.

However, freedom of expression comes with personal responsibility. Our philosophy is to provide players with the tools they need to shape their own experience while ensuring that basic community standards are upheld.

Smurfing is defined as the creation of a new account to play in lower ranked lobbies in order to easily achieve victory over your opponents. It is our belief that the responsibility of handling smurfs lies on us as the game operators. Our matchmaking and skill determination must be sophisticated enough to identify high skill players and quickly move them to their proper rating.

We will neither review nor enforce any punitive response to suspected smurfing. Instead, we will dedicate the resources to designing, engineering & iterating a system that allows minimal disruption from this activity.
Reborn empowers you to shape your own in-game experience:
Optional and customizable, blocks a wide range of offensive or vulgar language.

If a player is saying (text or voice) that you do not wish to read or hear, you can simply mute or block that account. After muting or blocking, you will no longer be subjected to what you deem offensive. It is not for Kongor Studios nor Juvio to determine what is or is not considered offensive.

Players are capable of avoiding other players if they find it detrimental to interact with that individual. The more players an account has avoided and the more avoids an account has will increase match making times. There are also negative consequences to being avoided.

If a player on your team is being disruptive, including what you consider overly offensive language in chat or voice comms, you can call a vote to kick that player. Successful kicks result in removal from the match, a loss and double MMR loss. It also comes with a severe punitive consequence of 8 Penalty Points.
All players are given 3 Avoids by default. Additional Avoids will be purchasable in the future.

Certain infractions are given Penalty Points (PP). Each infraction's points are accumulated over time. Increased PPs accumulation will result in increasing degrees of punishment. A single PP is removed for each game played with no additional infractions.
Auto AFK Detection - 2 PP (one time per match only)
Chad Title - amazing reward(s) - 2 Improper Game Play & Kick votes
Bro - normal rewards - 1 Improper Game Play & Kick
Sus - MM Queue Delay (5 minutes) - 1 Improper Game Play & Kick vote
Tool - MM Queue Delay (10 minutes), zero rewards, kicking only requires 3 votes to be kicked - Won't play their top 2 roles
Griefer - MM Queue Delay (20 minutes), zero rewards - Won't play their top 3 roles

At the end of a match players can vote for the MVP of the game. Each player is presented with a voting panel of their teammate and they select the player that they enjoyed playing with the most / had the most impact on the match.
The player with the most MVP votes is the MVP. Their MVP stats increase by 1 and a PP is removed from their account.

Players are expected to compete to win in every match at all times. This includes playing the game as intended, including but not limited to your assigned Role and without intentional actions to the detriment of the game or the community. Disallowed behavioral examples are:
Use of third-party software, scripts, macros, unauthorized modifications.
Exploiting bugs and/or glitches for any in-game advantage.
Intent to Lose / Sabotage / Refusal to Participate:
Any action to intentionally sabotage team performance
You must play your assigned role. Use the Role Swap feature for all changes of Role.
Destroying, selling, or dropping items in bad faith
Using abilities to intentionally harm or endanger teammates
Be nice! Behave in a way that is enjoyable. Use language that you want to be spoken in. Players will annoy you, exert discipline and walk away if you need to.

There is no capability to report a player. Our expectations of player behavior should be a reflection of the desire of our community, Kongor Studios / Juvio staff included. We provide the tools for self moderation within the game itself.

The Reborn team reserves the right to update or amend these rules to protect fair play, competitive integrity, and community trust. By playing Reborn, you acknowledge and agree to abide by this Code of Conduct.

If a player is behaving inappropriately, you can report them directly. Reports are reviewed by our moderators and may result in Penalty Points or other penalties for repeated offenses.
Reports from multiple players across matches are aggregated and reviewed.
When we are confident a violation has occurred, Penalty Points or other penalties are applied to the reported player.
